This was standard practice for large-cap filers before EDGAR filings were expected to be fully self-contained, and is a real (not synthetic) stress test of INCORPORATED_BY_REFERENCE status classification across most of a filing's substantive Part II content -- a pipeline that treats a short IBR pointer as 'missing' or as a low-confidence extraction failure would be wrong on 4 of this filing's 15 items. At December 29, 2001, there were approximately 21,000 holders of Textron Common Stock' is genuine extracted content, with the price/dividend detail alone incorporated by reference.
